name: Tooteh
summary: Spayed and fully vaccinated, with her vaccines kept up to date.
story:
I rescued Tooteh in 2022, when she was a tiny kitten near City Mall. She was skin and bones, and fungus had covered her whole body. Honestly, when I first saw her, I didn't think she would survive.

Tooteh was one of the cats I treated myself at home, without a clinic, with guidance from the house-call vet we work with. Slowly she healed and grew strong. Later she was spayed and vaccinated, and her vaccines are still kept up to date.

When I look at who she was and who she is now, I feel so proud. Tooteh lives with us.
